_README: Decision ledger for the Silver & Salt Capital task intake.
The daily granola-pull-dashboard-deploy task MUST read this file before proposing items.
Any item whose text or thread_id appears here with verdict not-a-task, done, superseded or
expired must NOT be re-proposed. snooze-until suppresses until the given date.
This file is committed to git on purpose: it is the memory the generator lacks.
Verdict 'expired' means the deadline passed and the item was escalated into the dashboard action list as overdue. It is suppressed from re-proposal, NOT dismissed.
